scope: git diff HEAD~1 — frontend/types/funnel.ts, FunnelTriggerSettings.vue, FunnelStepForm.vue, [funnelId].vue, uk.json, en.json, specs
summary: Frontend-only Phase-3 funnel-editor UI. Portable trigger component, EMIT_EVENT step, type + i18n changes. Clean, follows existing conventions (defineModel, SearchableSelect lazy-fetch + error-swallow, vee-validate schemaFor/onSubmit branch, data-test naming). No security/perf/resource concerns (presentational, no new heavy resources). All 402 frontend tests green; locale parity gate exit 0.

findings.finding: res.triggerType is typed string | null; cast `as FunnelTriggerType` is unchecked. A malformed/unknown backend value would render no value editor (selector matches nothing). The ?? 'on_start' only catches null.
findings.reason: Backend is the contract and only emits the five known values; this is a UX mirror. Same loose-cast idiom the codebase uses elsewhere (e.g. status). Not worth defensive narrowing for an impossible state.

findings.finding: The post-load deep-watch on [triggerType, triggerValue, keywords] fires once after seeding (loaded=true is set in the same sync block before the async watch callback), scheduling a debounced no-op PATCH of the just-loaded state.
findings.reason: Pre-existing behavior: the original watch(triggerValue) had the identical characteristic. Debounced (600ms) no-op re-PATCH of loaded state is harmless and preserves the established auto-save pattern. Changing it would be scope creep beyond the task.

findings.finding: Trigger component is self-contained per Decision 11: state via defineModel only, no store coupling beyond the lazy tag/field fetch (same idiom as FunnelStepForm). Migrates unchanged into a future canvas node.
